::: {.block title="2. Is there hope for coastal regions?"}
Measured as SOCA2024 validates its open-ocean product, our model does as well on the
continental slope as in the open ocean (@tbl-coastal), and it predicts integrated Chl *a*
best on the slope (@fig-coastal). On the shelf it captures the surface but not the profile:
predictions are too flat, and few whole shelf profiles exist. There is hope for the slope;
the jury is still out for the shelf.

| | r² (log10) | Slope | MAPD | RMSD (mg m⁻³) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| SOCA2024 (open ocean) | 0.83 | 0.82 | 30% | 0.19 |
| Open ocean | 0.69 | 0.69 | 43% | 0.22 |
| Slope | 0.72 | 0.71 | 41% | 0.53 |
| Shelf | 0.31 | 0.41 | 44% | 0.75 |

: Skill on held-out data with SOCA2024's validation metrics, all depths pooled. Data: open ocean 13,544 profiles or OOI windows (819 floats or OOI sites); slope 5,331 (43); shelf 11,621 (11). SOCA2024 row from its own validation. {#tbl-coastal}
